basic_info.description: This spacious 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom residence with terrace at The Brannan offers refined living in the heart of South Beach. Overlooking the landscaped pool and framed by sweeping Bay views, the south-facing terrace extends from the living room, offering a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living. Inside, Black Oak floors anchor an open-concept living and dining area, with a well-appointed kitchen featuring granite countertops, Dornbracht fixtures, and a suite of appliances by Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Bosch. The bedroom suite enjoys abundant natural light, southern views, a well-appointed bath, and custom closet cabinetry. Additional highlights include a Sub-Zero wine cooler, Bosch in-home laundry, Lutron lighting and shade control with AV integration, one-car parking, and storage unit. The Brannan elevates daily living with a 24/7 doorman, full-time concierge, well-equipped fitness room, outdoor heated pool, spa, and cabana with kitchen appliances. Conveniently located off the Embarcadero, residents enjoy proximity to the Farmers' Market, Chase Center, and Oracle Park. Public transit, grocery stores, restaurants, and flat blocks for leisurely strolls complete the urban convenience.
